title: Pig
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='34' ry='24' fill='#f48fb1'/>
  <!-- body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='26' ry='16' fill='#f8b4cc'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='28' y='78' width='10' height='14' rx='4' fill='#d96d94'/>
  <rect x='62' y='78' width='10' height='14' rx='4' fill='#d96d94'/>

  <rect x='28' y='88' width='10' height='4' rx='2' fill='#a84368'/>
  <rect x='62' y='88' width='10' height='4' rx='2' fill='#a84368'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <path d='M22 36 Q16 20 32 30 Z' fill='#e573a3'/>
  <path d='M78 36 Q84 20 68 30 Z' fill='#e573a3'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='26' ry='20' fill='#f48fb1'/>
  <!-- head highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='20' ry='14' fill='#f8b4cc'/>

  <circle cx='39' cy='40' r='4' fill='#2b1a33'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='40' r='4' fill='#2b1a33'/>

  <circle cx='40' cy='38.5' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='38.5' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='53' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#e573a3'/>
  <!-- nostril -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='53' rx='2.5' ry='3.5' fill='#a84368'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='53' rx='2.5' ry='3.5' fill='#a84368'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M42 60 Q50 66 58 60' fill='none' stroke='#a84368' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M84 58 Q92 54 88 62 Q84 70 90 66' fill='none' stroke='#e573a3' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
